name: conversation_persistence
objective: Guard the append-only conversation journal: history must survive a restart, and compaction must shrink only the in-memory window while the journal keeps every turn.

persistence_correctness.description: Fraction of cases where the rebuilt window, the full on-disk history, and any pending questions all match after a simulated restart. Reloading the module is the restart: the module-level session dict starts empty, so anything read back had to come from the journal.

constraints: Each case runs in its own temp directory, so the suite never touches real data/.
Compaction uses a stub summarizer, not the LLM: the invariant under test is that the journal keeps every turn, not the quality of the summary.
Idle-timeout cases rewrite timestamps in the journal rather than sleeping, so the suite runs in milliseconds instead of an hour.
Cases assert the full on-disk history explicitly, not just the window. A bug that silently drops journal lines would still produce a plausible-looking window.

baseline.note: 建立时锁住两个刚修复的缺陷：会话历史只存在内存里，进程重启即清空；以及压缩把老消息换成摘要后原文永久丢失。
